A CLEAR ACCOUNT

Privacy, with the edges shown.

Daymark keeps your daybook on your device. It has no Daymark account, analytics, cloud sync, or remote AI service. Some features you choose use other services; this page names them plainly.

What stays in Daymark

Tasks, events you create, rituals and check-ins, focus sessions and timers, Shelf entries, and weekly reviews are stored by the app on your iPhone or iPad. Ask Daymark reads a local view of your daybook. The optional Gemma model runs on your device after download; its prompts stay there.

If you connect Apple Calendar or Reminders, Daymark reads only the calendars and lists you select. Changes you make to imported items can be written back through Apple’s system services. If a selected calendar or list belongs to an account that syncs, that sync follows the account provider’s settings on your device.

When Daymark uses the network

These connections belong to specific features. They do not send your whole daybook.

Weather and place search

Forecasts use Apple WeatherKit. Place search, and a fallback forecast when WeatherKit is unavailable, use Open-Meteo. The place you search for and its coordinates are sent to those services.

Link details on the Shelf

When you add a link, Daymark requests that page from its website to read the title and description. The website receives that request like a normal visit.

Optional web search

Web search is off by default. If you turn it on and search in Open chat, only your question is sent to DuckDuckGo. DuckDuckGo Instant Answer and Wikipedia can be used as fallbacks. Your daybook and its history are not included in the search request.

Optional on-device model

The Gemma 4 model is downloaded only after you choose it. The download comes from Hugging Face; after it is installed, the model runs locally. You can remove the downloaded model in Settings.

What export and restore include

A Daymark daybook export contains tasks, events, Shelf records, and sample-data metadata. It does not include rituals or check-ins, focus history or timers, weekly reviews, assistant chat, or the images saved on the Shelf. The daily on-device restore copies cover that same limited file and keep up to seven copies. These tools are not a complete backup of every kind of Daymark data.

Before moving to another device or relying on an export, check that it contains the records you need. The app does not provide automatic cloud sync for its daybook.

This website

This static site uses no cookies, analytics, or third-party assets. Its styles, scripts, icons, and images are served from the site itself.
